operation.summary: Ask the owner to install an applet package. Nothing runs and nothing is granted until the owner approves it once on the phone; then the phone creates its watches, schedule, workflow and card itself and keeps them running without you

body.name: package
body.description: The applet file itself: a bridgit-template/1 definition with runtime.adapter bridgit.package.v1 (legacy alias android.package.v1; see https://bridgit.cc/learn/builder/applet-packages.md)

body.name: url
body.description: Instead of package: an https://bridgit.cc/… package file (for example a recipe's applet.json)

body.name: template
body.description: Instead of package: a template registry key (with revision)

body.name: bundled
body.description: Instead of package/url/template: a built-in applet id (including a-sorta-fairytale-about-me, chef-helper, insurance-inventory, exercise-check); downloads its registry release

body.name: config
body.description: Values for the applet's blanks (config_schema); the rest use defaults. The owner can still change them on the review screen

operation.returns: status awaiting_owner, pending_id, review (as validate). applet.installed or applet.declined follows in /v1/events
